Tired of fighting black-box constraints and heavy runtime bloat in commercial game engines? 🛑

Meet BRUTAL: an open-source C# framework giving developers bare-metal performance and direct native API access to build custom game engines from scratch without the bloat. 🚀

Most modern game engines force you into rigid, opinionated workflows that drain performance and trigger constant garbage collection. BRUTAL bridges the gap between high-level C# development and low-level execution, acting as a foundational kernel that delivers 2x to 4x faster performance than traditional builds.

🔥 Key Features:
• Custom Interop Layer: Direct, low-level access to native APIs and libraries with zero unnecessary overhead.
• Zero-Allocation Memory: Unmanaged collections and string handling designed to completely eliminate garbage collection pressure.
• Modular NuGet Suite: Decoupled packages covering Vulkan, GLFW, Dear ImGui, FMOD, Jolt physics, RakNet networking, and job scheduling.
• Modern .NET 10: Leveraging the absolute latest C# language features and unsafe code blocks for maximum speed.

Whether you are an indie studio looking to ditch royalty fees, a systems programmer, or a developer wanting total control over your render loop and memory management, BRUTAL gives you absolute architectural freedom. ⚙️

Check out the repository and start building your custom engine today:
https://github.com/ahwootech/BRUTAL

Classic Git workflows were built for humans who code for hours and push once a day. But what happens when a fleet of autonomous AI agents tries to generate thousands of concurrent tasks on a shared branch? 

Total gridlock. 🛑

Enter Gitai (git-ai): a server-centric version control system entirely reimagined for the age of AI coding agents and implemented using Anthropic's Scion architecture. 

It completely eliminates traditional bottlenecks by moving heavy lifting like history walks, blame, and code search directly to the server. Instead of struggling with sluggish merge queues, Gitai uses atomic compare-and-swap operations and automated conflict resolvers (driven by deterministic tools or LLMs) to land changes in seconds. 🚀

Key Features:
• Server-Centric API and Derived Data: Offloads resource-intensive tasks and memoizes results per commit.
• Queue-Free Landing: Uses UserLand to rebase changes onto the current tip instantly.
• Changeset Log & Real-Time Monitoring: Records every reference update in a dense, ordered log that clients can watch live.
• Decoupled Storage Core: Separates transactional metadata (SQLite/PostgreSQL) from content-addressed object storage (S3, GCS, Azure, Local).

Whether you are deploying autonomous agents to tackle enterprise bug fixes or scaling high-concurrency CI/CD pipelines, Gitai gives you the high-performance version control layer your stack needs. 

Check out the repo, drop it into your workflow, and let your agents code concurrently without the clone lag:
https://github.com/feder-cr/git-ai

Tired of heavy, sluggish legacy GIS software that chokes on massive datasets and demands complex server setups? 🌍💥

Meet RustGIS: a high-performance, open-source Geographic Information System written entirely in pure Rust. It brings lightning-fast, memory-safe geospatial processing, raster rendering, and 1,000+ GIS tools natively to your desktop, browser, and Python pipelines.

Built for geospatial developers, data scientists, and Python engineers, RustGIS delivers native performance across Windows, macOS, Linux, and WebAssembly without the massive external runtimes.

🚀 Key Features:

⚡ GPU-drawn, cross-platform native and WebAssembly rendering supporting thousands of vector formats, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs), LiDAR point clouds, and live PostGIS or DuckDB spatial integrations.
🛠️ Built-in integration with over 1,000 GeoLibre and Whitebox geoprocessing tools for advanced terrain, hydrology, and remote sensing workflows.
🤖 Command-driven architecture where every GUI action maps to a unique scriptable command ID, making it easy to automate pipelines via CLI, Python notebooks, or local AI assistants.
🌐 Sandboxed WebAssembly plugin registry, supporting 3D globes, multiple projections, and publication-ready cartography.

Whether you are building zero-install browser mapping tools with WebAssembly or automating heavy spatial analysis in Python via PyPI, RustGIS keeps your workflows fast, memory-safe, and dependency-light.

👉 Check out the repo and star the project:

Tired of wrestling with messy multimodal setups and losing character consistency in your generative pipelines? 🎨🤖

Check out Arekejoker/qwen21-nsfw-pose-skill—an open-source agent skill framework integrating Qwen-Image 2.1 with granular 3D pose control and modular generation pipelines for ComfyUI. 

This repository bridges advanced multimodal image generation with precise structural pose manipulation and identity preservation. It provides a standardized agent skill recipe compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw to execute repeatable, high-fidelity image synthesis workflows.

🚀 Key Features:
• Integrated Multi-Route Pipeline: Supports four operational workflows from standard Text-to-Image with LoRA, img2img identity/pose editing, to browser-assisted 3D VNCCS PoseStudio automation.
• Comprehensive 3D Pose Control Library: Includes 136 curated poses mapped to MakeHuman and three.js rendering frameworks.
• Automated Diagnostic Suite: Features a robust doctor script (scripts/doctor.py) that validates ComfyUI connectivity, model weights, LoRA files, and browser dependencies prior to execution.
• Strict Prompt Engineering Recipes: Enforces structured 7-element, high-density prompting strategies paired with optimized ComfyUI samplers to replicate exact author-grade outputs.

Whether you are building automated visual asset generation pipelines or embedding specialized image-control skills into autonomous AI agents, this repo serves as a powerful blueprint for wrapping local ComfyUI APIs and executing programmatic multi-step image tasks.

Explore the code and level up your AI workflows today:

Want to build an AI chat interface that looks and feels exactly like the official Claude desktop app? 

Reverse-engineered using REA, Open Claude UI delivers a production-grade, pixel-accurate clone of the Claude desktop design system complete with physics-based spring animations and native audio synthesis.

For frontend engineers, UI/UX designers, and AI app developers, replicating sophisticated conversational interfaces usually means endless guesswork with CSS and motion design. This project solves that challenge by providing a comprehensive, open-source React component library and interaction physics engine reverse-engineered directly from the official client, giving you exact CSS tokens and components without relying on proprietary binaries.

Top Features Built Right In:
* Strict design system tokens including 4-layer low-contrast surfaces, Editorial Warmth clay colors, hairline ring borders, and retina font-weight compensation.
* Advanced interaction physics featuring 4-stage spring configurations, 7-stop non-linear alpha fade scroll masks, and CJK input method composition guards.
* Comprehensive audiovisual and architecture modules such as zero-latency synthetic Web Audio API prompt tones, cursor-anchored image pan/zoom, and macOS vibrancy styling.
* Extensive reverse-engineering documentation and an interactive component storybook for immediate offline preview.

Whether you are building custom web-based AI chat interfaces that require an elite, human-centric design aesthetic or studying advanced animation physics and non-linear CSS masking techniques, this repository is an educational masterclass.

Check out the source code and start building today:
https://github.com/Caho1/open-claude-ui
